datasetVersion.termsOfUse:
To use this dataset, an application must be submitted to firmbackbone@uu.nl including a motivation for using the data (max. 150 words). A broad description suffices. Please note the following:
  • The applicant must be affiliated with at a Dutch university (contractual agreement), at a department that is a member of the ODISSEI consortium (see the full list here);
  • Access to students is only granted if the course they are enrolled in is approved by the FIRMBACKBONE Data Board;
  • This dataset can only be used for research purposes, and the requested purpose may not deviate from the final application of the data. Commercial and data extraction purposes are immediately rejected;
  • To gain access, uses will be required to sign a user statement;
  • The dataset can be accessed only via the Tinker Secure ANalysis Environment (Tinker SANE) and access will be granted for three months (extensions can be requested). SANE and SURF user terms will have to be signed. More information on SANE can be found here;
  • There are no costs for using the data. However, there are costs associated with infrastructure usage (SANE) which can be covered by a Small Compute Grant via the NWO or paid directly to SURF;
  • The Data Access Protocol (see "Files") specifies data access conditions in larger details;
  • To know more about the data access process, please visit the FIRMBACKBONE website

fields.value: FIRMBACKBONE Employment Data on all Dutch Entities

dsDescriptionValue.value:
FIRMBACKBONE provides a longitudinal, cross-sectional (panel data) database that contains information about all Dutch organizations with legal status. It consists of the corporate register and provides financial information via annual reports, employment information and information captured from organization websites with support for mode data. Depending on the source, different datasets are provided once or multiple times per year.

This is the FIRMBACKBONE LISA Employment Survey database and consists of all Dutch organizations that are surveyed by LISA in 2019-2022. The granularity level of this database is at the establishment level. The employment information is mostly retrieved from survey results and through imputation techniques. Sometimes additional increases are reported (and documented) individually.

fields.value:
The dataset comprises four different waves of the LISA survey from the years:
  • 2019
  • 2020
  • 2021
  • 2022

The variables available in the dataset are listed under Social Science and Humanities Metadata> Notes. For more details, categories and descriptive statistics, see the codebook available for download at https://doi.org/10.34894/V4NWYG.

The dataset includes organizations with legal status based in the Netherlands (Country, Province, City and 4-digit Postcode level)

value: All organizations with legal status that are registered at the Dutch Chambers of Commerce (KVK).

socialScienceNotesText.value:
The dataset includes the variables listed below. For more details, categories and descriptive statistics, see the codebook available for download at https://doi.org/10.34894/V4NWYG.
  • fbb_id: Observation based identifier (UUID), used for record linkage, unique for each organization and establishment combination.
  • fbb_grp_id: Firm based identifier (UUID), used for record linkage and firm-based lineage.
  • fbb_est_id: Establishment based identifier (UUID), used for record linkage and establishment-based lineage. Although some registrations are not considered an establishment (a long-term physical firm location), each location still gets an identifier by FIRMBACKBONE.
  • fbb_row_id: Row based identifier (UUID), primarily used for duplicate checking.
  • fbb_file_id: File based identifier (UUID), used for tracking source file lineage. For future reference, a file with the same code in its filename is stored in the bronze data location.
  • fbb_wave_id: Date based identifier (YYYY-MM-DD) which is provided for each wave (containing the date of when the source snapshot was made).
  • fbb_updated: Date based column (YYYY-MM-DD) that holds the date when the record was added to the dataset.
  • fbb_deleted: Date based column (YYYY-MM-DD) that holds the date when a new record was added that replaces the current row. The row is kept in the dataset for data lineage. This field should be blank exactly once for each unique fbb_id.
  • fbb_source: Indicates the source (original provider) of the data.
  • sbi_description: Description of the full standard business classification code (SBI-2008) provided (in Dutch). Details see: https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/our-services/methods/classifications/activiteiten/standard-industrial-classifications
  • sbi_sector_int: No description provided
  • sbi_sector_str: No description provided
  • code_sbi_1: Full SBI-2008 business classification code, see: https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/our-services/methods/classifications/activiteiten/standard-industrial-classifications
  • code_sbi_2: First 2-digits of the SBI-2008 business classification code, see: https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/our-services/methods/classifications/activiteiten/standard-industrial-classifications
  • code_sbi_3: First 3-digits of the SBI-2008 business classification code, see: https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/our-services/methods/classifications/activiteiten/standard-industrial-classifications
  • code_sbi_4: First 4-digits of the SBI-2008 business classification code, see: https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/our-services/methods/classifications/activiteiten/standard-industrial-classifications
  • establishment_size_category: Indication of the overall size of the establishment given the number of fulltime jobs provided (parttime jobs are excluded), which is in-line with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce classification.
  • number_of_jobs: Indicates number of full-time and part-time jobs provided by the establishment. Please note that this is not the same as the number of people (a person could have a contract and be self employed at the same time, resulting in 1 person having 2 jobs).
  • number_of_establishments: No description provided
  • employees_fulltime: The number of full-time employees that are working at a specific establishment. An employee is considered full-time when active for at least 12 hours per week (which is in-line with the definition by Statistics Netherlands).
  • employees_parttime: The number of part-time employees that are working at a specific establishment. An employee is considered full-time when active less than 12 hours per week (which is in-line with the definition by Statistics Netherlands).
  • employees_female: The total number of female employees working at the establishment.
  • employees_female_fulltime: The total number of female employees working full-time (>=12 hours per week) at the establishment.
  • employees_female_parttime: The total number of female employees working part-time (<12 hours per week)at the establishment.
  • employees_male: The total number of male employees working at the establishment.
  • employees_male_fulltime: The total number of male employees working full-time (>=12 hours per week) at the establishment.
  • employees_male_parttime: The total number of male employees working part-time (<12 hours per week) at the establishment.
  • bag_object_surface: This variable indicates the total area of the workspace in square meters.
  • bag_object_usage: This indicates to what purpose or function the object is associated.
  • establishment_pc4: The first 4 digits of the postal code of the establishment.
  • establishment_city: No description provided
  • establishment_code_corop: Code of the region as defined by Statistics Netherlands, see: https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/achtergrond/2023/10/kaarten-regionale-indelingen-2023.
  • establishment_code_labor_region: Code of the region as defined by the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency (UWV), see: https://www.samenvoordeklant.nl/sites/default/files/bestandsbijlage/Arbeidsmarktregio%27s_vs_08-12-2022.pdf.
  • establishment_code_lisa_region: No description provided
  • establishment_code_municipality: A 4-digit code, in some other sources preceded by GM, of the municipality as defined by the Dutch government. See for a full list or more details: https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/onze-diensten/methoden/classificaties/overig/gemeentelijke-indelingen-per-jaar/indeling-per-jaar/gemeentelijke-indeling-op-1-januari-2024
  • establishment_code_province: A 2-digit code, in some other sources preceded by PV, of the province as defined by the Dutch government.
  • establishment_name_corop: Name of the COROP region as assigned by Statistics Netherlands, see: https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/achtergrond/2023/10/kaarten-regionale-indelingen-2023.
  • establishment_name_labor_region: Name of the region as defined by the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency (UWV), see: https://www.samenvoordeklant.nl/sites/default/files/bestandsbijlage/Arbeidsmarktregio%27s_vs_08-12-2022.pdf.
  • establishment_name_lisa_region: Name of the region that LISA uses to collect the data (administrative purposes).
  • establishment_name_municipality: Name of the municipality as defined by the Dutch government. See for a full list or more details: https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/onze-diensten/methoden/classificaties/overig/gemeentelijke-indelingen-per-jaar/indeling-per-jaar/gemeentelijke-indeling-op-1-januari-2024
  • establishment_name_province: Name of the province as defined by the Dutch government.
  • counts_raised: In case of non-response to the survey, within the categories male/female and full-time/part-time, the number of employees is adjusted relative to companies with a similar size category.
  • lisa_survey_type: There are different types of surveys conducted by LISA, which are indicated here.
  • survey_content_year: The last two digits of the year for which the survey was filled out.
  • survey_form_received: Indicates if the establishment has received a survey form.
  • survey_registration: Indicates how the establishment has provided the information.
  • month_lisa_processed: The month in which the LISA survey was processed.
  • year_lisa_processed: The year in which the LISA survey was processed.
  • month_cancelled: The month in which the establishment was cancelled (when originally included in the survey respondents). In the next survey wave, the cancelled establishment is not surveyed any more.
  • year_cancelled: The year in which the establishment was cancelled (when originally included in the survey respondents). In the next survey wave, the cancelled establishment is not surveyed any more.
  • month_founded: The month in which the organization was founded.
  • year_founded: The year in which the organization was founded.
